verdict.rationale: Ramp documents instant virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits (ramp-docs-31). The live MCP server exposes limits:write, cards:write and spend_programs scopes (ramp-probe-4). The CLI can list, lock and manage funds, and a user confirms new expense cards spin up in under a minute (ramp-comm-2). Together these support the per-card limit core. However, granular per-employee controls are only documented for AI agents (per agent/task/merchant restrictions), not for human employees. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-employee card limits and granular controls (merchant/category restrictions, time windows, policy per cardholder), and independent hands-on corroboration of limit configuration.
